# openwebui_tasks_config (Resource)

Manages Open WebUI's title/tag/autocomplete/follow-up task-model generation settings. This is a singleton resource.

~> This resource does a full-object update: any attribute not explicitly set in your configuration will be reset to its zero value (false/0/empty string) on every apply. Because prompt-template attributes are written verbatim, omitting them blanks the corresponding prompt on the server — set every template you rely on explicitly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openwebui_tasks_config" "example" {
  enable_title_generation          = true
  title_generation_prompt_template = "Generate a concise 3-5 word title for this conversation."
  enable_tags_generation           = true
  enable_autocomplete_generation   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `autocomplete_generation_input_max_length` (Number) Maximum input length considered for autocomplete generation.
- `autocomplete_generation_prompt_template` (String) Prompt template used for autocomplete generation. Always sent on write, including as an empty string when unset. On an Open WebUI release at or before v0.9.6, the read response may omit this key entirely, which is read back as an empty string.
- `enable_autocomplete_generation` (Boolean) Whether inline autocomplete suggestions are generated.
- `enable_follow_up_generation` (Boolean) Whether follow-up suggestions are generated.
- `enable_retrieval_query_generation` (Boolean) Whether knowledge-retrieval queries are auto-generated from chat context.
- `enable_search_query_generation` (Boolean) Whether web-search queries are auto-generated from chat context.
- `enable_tags_generation` (Boolean) Whether chat tags are auto-generated.
- `enable_title_generation` (Boolean) Whether chat titles are auto-generated.
- `enable_voice_mode_prompt` (Boolean) Whether a dedicated voice-mode system prompt is used.
- `follow_up_generation_prompt_template` (String) Prompt template used to generate follow-up suggestions.
- `image_prompt_generation_prompt_template` (String) Prompt template used to generate image-generation prompts.
- `query_generation_prompt_template` (String) Prompt template used for search/retrieval query generation.
- `tags_generation_prompt_template` (String) Prompt template used to generate chat tags.
- `task_model` (String) Model ID used for internal generation tasks (title, tags, etc.) when not using the chat model.
- `task_model_external` (String) Model ID used for internal generation tasks when the chat backend is an external API.
- `title_generation_prompt_template` (String) Prompt template used to generate chat titles.
- `tools_function_calling_prompt_template` (String) Prompt template used for tools function-calling generation.
- `voice_mode_prompt_template` (String) Prompt template used in voice mode.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identifier.
